name: trello
description: Connect Trello to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Trello MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Trello to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with boards, lists and cards using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Trello workspace.
Find anything in Trello that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review boards, lists and cards in Trello.
